source_snapshot.procedure: Verify UART between HMC and USB-C is functional.
source_snapshot.criteria: UART is functioning normally and can send and receive traffic.
source_snapshot.script: No bundle; 20 attended/20 machine minutes; unique row/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; logs into the DUT host and lists host USB tty nodes without proving they are the HMC UART.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/MEDIUM; held Pending for HMC-native/proxy ownership, UART/USB-C endpoint map, service ownership/recovery, peer, serial profile and traffic oracle.

old_problem: The source subject is HMC, but the proposed host tty enumeration may see an unrelated adapter. No architecture establishes HMC-native access or a documented proxy to the physical USB-C endpoint, so the command target and management recovery path are unknown.
disposition_reason: HMC controller/access ownership is core command semantics, not merely a tty parameter. Until the project proves which endpoint represents the HMC UART and how an independent HMC recovery route is maintained, traffic could target a host or privileged HMC console. A bidirectional test can be parameterized only after that architecture decision; Pending remains.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2168, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2169 / Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00056-V002 / da25d54c7ffdcb70 was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
Owner must establish HMC-native or documented proxy access and map the HMC UART controller/channel through USB-C/adapter to a stable endpoint.
Host ttyACM/ttyUSB enumeration is acceptable only with specification-backed proof it terminates the named HMC path.
Before traffic, identify console/debug/service ownership and an independent HMC management recovery channel.
After architecture approval, bind operator peer, serial profile and bounded two-way frames with exact byte/error criteria.
Reject host-device substitution, unknown-console writes, credentials/control escapes, service disruption, reset and automatic retry.
No HMC/host enumeration, port open, physical connection, traffic, reset, retry or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: HMC-owned UART-to-USB-C bidirectional and management-safety validation
test_case.purpose: Prove the HMC's own UART is physically routed to USB-C and carries exact two-way traffic through its authoritative native or documented proxy endpoint without affecting HMC management.
required_package: Approved HMC-native or exact proxy access and UART ownership specification
Console/debug/service ownership and independent HMC recovery path
Operator-approved isolated peer plus serial profile, bounded payload and limits
Complete HMC/USB/UART logs, cleanup and recovery
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED pending Engineering Decision. Do not enumerate or write candidate host tty devices until HMC ownership and the exact native/proxy endpoint are approved. Then operator attaches the isolated peer and the approved endpoint may exchange the signed bounded frames both ways while recording byte/error integrity and continuous independent HMC health.
test_case.expected_result: The endpoint is proven to be the named HMC UART/USB-C path, both directions deliver exact approved frames within limits, no console/service interaction occurs and independent HMC management remains healthy.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until HMC ownership/access identity is authoritative. PASS then requires physical/path evidence and complete two-way integrity plus management health. FAIL on host/wrong endpoint, byte/error limit breach or management impact. Missing ownership/proxy remains BLOCKED.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until HMC ownership/proxy, endpoint topology, service ownership and recovery are signed.
No host tty substitution, sole-console write, service stop, control escape, unbounded traffic, reset or automatic retry.
Stop on wrong-owner response, prompt/debug interaction, HMC degradation, reset/disconnect or UART error.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, authorization and HMC ownership/native-proxy diagram
HMC UART/channel-to-USB-C/adapter/endpoint map and operator photo
Endpoint console/debug/service ownership and independent recovery proof
Exact profile and two-way frames with byte/order/count/timeout/error comparison
Continuous HMC management and pre/post logs plus restored state
test_case.recovery: Stop on wrong ownership or management impact, preserve evidence and close the endpoint without more traffic. Use only the approved independent HMC recovery route; do not reset HMC/USB/UART or retry until the architecture and failure are resolved.

source_conflict.reason: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently require HMC-to-USB-C bidirectional UART function; the host assumption exists only in the non-authoritative AI proposal.

blocked.reason: Execution remains REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION, while the Engineering Decision stays Pending because the HMC execution surface and recovery semantics are unknown.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: HMC-native/proxy ownership, controller/USB-C/endpoint map, service ownership/recovery, peer, serial profile, bounded traffic oracle and cleanup.
pending.execution_status: ENGINEERING DECISION PENDING; HMC UART ACCESS GATE CLOSED; NO ENUMERATION, PORT OPEN, PHYSICAL CONNECTION, TRAFFIC, RESET, RETRY OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED
pending.owner: HMC architecture/firmware owner, platform UART/USB owner and management recovery authority
pending.unlock_condition: Approve the authoritative HMC-native or exact proxy UART endpoint and independent recovery, then bind the traffic contract and re-review.

external_authorities.application: Requires correct target/interface identity, physical evidence, secure access, recovery and no guessed commands or retries.

project_authority: HMC architecture owner defines ownership/proxy; platform owner defines endpoint topology; management owner defines service ownership/recovery; engineer owns verdict.
